evidence_quotes.quote: Contracting water services with public and private partners: a case study approach
Francisco Silva Pinto, Nuno Ferreira da Cruz and Rui Cunha Marques
In this paper we compare the contracts of two Portuguese utilities with different governance models: a public–private partnership and a public–public partnership.
